title: The Levins metapopulation model
caption: dp/dt = 0.4p(1 − p) − 0.1p is positive for small p and negative beyond p* = 1 − e/c = 0.75, so the occupied fraction settles at three-quarters of the patches.
alt: A downward parabola of the rate of change of the occupied fraction p against p, crossing zero at p = 0 and at the stable equilibrium p = 0.75.
description: The rate of change is positive for 0 < p < 0.75 and negative for p > 0.75.
It is zero at p* = 1 − e/c = 0.75: three-quarters of the patches are occupied.

checks.name: the rate peaks half-way between 0 and p*
